exact_local_claim.setup: Fix one target/base object x. Let W_full(x) be the legal full Definition-21 witness class, and let W_res(x) be any restricted legal witness class with W_res(x) subseteq W_full(x). Define rho_full(x)=inf{|w|:w in W_full(x)} and rho_res(x)=inf{|w|:w in W_res(x)}, using +infinity when a class is empty.
exact_local_claim.claim: rho_full(x) <= rho_res(x). Consequently, a lower bound rho_res(x) >= L does not by itself imply rho_full(x) >= L.
exact_local_claim.proof: The infimum is taken over a superset for rho_full. Every restricted witness is also a full witness, so the best full witness can be no more expensive than the best restricted witness. The implication from a restricted lower bound to a full lower bound therefore has the wrong polarity unless an independent reverse comparison or a direct full-model lower bound is proved.
